messages:
mia (AE): Eva from RegBank needs confirmation: EU-only data residency for inference + fixed egress IPs for their firewall. also they asked whether control plane metadata can be excluded from non-EU flows.
rajesh (SE): Yes for data plane. We can hard_pin to eu regions so inference, KV cache, and storage stay in EU. Control plane is global in Hosted unless Private is chosen.
lina (Infra PM): For Hosted we publish per-region CIDR bundles; not single fixed IP. Dedicated/Private can provide static NAT egress IP(s).
tom (Security): We can disable request-level telemetry and redact logs for the tenant. Need to note this in the DPA. SOC2 available via compliance portal after NDA.
mia (AE): Eva, do you require control plane pinned as well or is telemetry disable sufficient?
eva (Customer): Inference + logs must remain in EU. Control plane metadata ok if no PII. They want signed SOC2 and a one-page summary for procurement.
legal-bot: DPA v3.2 has checkbox for private control plane option and standard subprocessor disclosure.
rajesh (SE): If the requested model isn't in EU we can replicate it; estimate: 24-72h and one-time storage/transfer cost ~0.3 USD/GiB (ballpark).
lina (Infra PM): Action: I'll produce CIDR bundle + Dedicated NAT pricing. target EOD PT.
tom (Security): Action: I'll draft the 3-paragraph security note (telemetry, log retention, KMS options).
mia (AE): I'll compile and send procurement packet once items are in. Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 CET?
eva (Customer): Yes please. Thanks.
(THREAD END)
